text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing.
I stopped by the amusement park with Fusaichi Pandora, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehhh!!??
For real, you're going home already!?
choice_data_list: Sorry, some urgent work came up.
I'm sorry, some urgent work came up.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Who caaares, it's fine~!
A little bit won't hurt, right?"
choice_data_list: It's not that simple... I'm really sorry!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm.
Well, not that I care either way~~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I still wanna play more~♪
And I can have a blast even all by myself☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well~ then. Where should I go first?~♪
—Huh? Isn't that back...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Waha! It's the upperclassmen!
Lucky~~☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, little pony.
Did you come to play too?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That's so true~ But, like,
Trainer went home early.
I'm so lonely I could literally cry, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I see. Well then, want to hang out together?
It's definitely more fun when it's lively♪"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure~?
Yaaay! Thanks a bunch♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The fishies are so crazy cool~~☆ It's like the Dragon Palace~!
This is 3D? No way, that's impossible!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It's much more intense
than the aquarium I usually go to—...eek!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~!!
Was that a shark that just crossed by!? That had to be a shark!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh~~☆ We might get eaten alive~~!
That guy would totally freak out like, "Gyaaah!"♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Wait, no no. My Trainer isn't even here right now.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~, so buono♡
I just found another delicious restaurant♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Totally~♪ Ah, but wait, maybe that waffle shop over there looks tempting too?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right?! At times like this, you get people
to buy both, then take a bite of each!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And then I could be like, 'Which one do you like better~?' and stuff~~...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, like I said!
They're not here right now!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Are you all right?
You seem a bit down."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~... I guess it's a teensy bit off from what I expected.
Or like, it doesn't get me hyped as much as I thought~...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see. Could it be
you wanted to play with someone else?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For example—yes.
Like "him" running over from the other side.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For example—yes.
Like "her" running over from the other side.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of the crowd, I spotted Fusaichi Pandora
standing with some other Umamusume.
I rushed over to her.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!?
But, but what about work...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I did leave early for work, sure, but she seemed
less energetic than usual when we parted.
That's why—
choice_data_list: I was worried about you, so I rushed to get it done.
I was worried about you, so I hurried to finish.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: You were worried about me...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so...?
Huuuh~~...? Hmm…………

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Geez, Trainer, you carrot-brain!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're a Trainer!? You're someone who can scout me, aren't you!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And yet, why're you leavin' me behind~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Think about me!
Pay way, waaaay more attention to meee~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, that really stung, you know!
It really did—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: If you leave me behind next time, I won't forgive you!
choice_data_list: I'll do anything to make it up to you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
…………
...Will you ride the attraction with me?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Then, you're forgiven♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"We'll take our leave now.
Go and enjoy your date with your Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!
I'm gonna totally make up for getting left behind♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with the senior Umamusume,
she went on to enjoy the attractions with Fusaichi Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"N-Not at all, okay? That's totally not true!
...Yup, definitely not!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Haha!
And after you were sulking so much earlier, too!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, waaaait!
Dooon't saaaay thaaat—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, Fusaichi Pandora stepped closer and tightly gripped my sleeve.
